Caspian's total shipped size targets a 1.44 MB floppy — **1,474,560 bytes**. The pie below is regenerated by `tools/build.lua` on every build from the actual bytes at `~/projects/puck/ecoverse/build/`. The [core inventory](https://puck.uno/requirements/core/#contents) lists what feeds each slice.

![Caspian floppy budget pie: caspian binary, caspian.lua, cache, wiggle room, free — dynamically regenerated by tools/build.lua](./floppy-budget.svg)

## Slices

- **caspian binary** — the compiled `bin/caspian`: Lua 5.4 interpreter (statically linked), musl libc, and the CLI shim (`caspian.c`). Measured directly from the built binary. This is what runs when you type `caspian` at the shell.
- **caspian.lua** — the bundled runtime at `caspian/caspian.lua`: Caspian-authored code (engine, Fiona with SQL inlined, Lua binding wrapper) plus every pure-Lua wrapper from the always-loaded external libraries — pegasus, luasocket's Lua side, dkjson, etc. Measured directly. Every host that embeds Caspian loads this one file.
- **cache** — libraries downloaded as part of the distribution but NOT bundled into `caspian.lua`. They ship on disk under `build/cache/` and load via `require()` only when a program actually reaches for them. XML support (`luaexpat`: `lxp.so` + its Lua helpers) lives here — parsing / memory cost only paid by programs that touch XML. Sum of every file under `build/cache/`.
- **wiggle room** — 100 kb of reserved slack. Absorbs surprise growth without triggering a budget alert.
- **free** — whatever's left of the 1.44 MB target after the four above.

## Not shown in the pie

External libraries with C bindings the engine's default path depends on — libsodium, LPeg, cjson, lsqlite3, socket/core, mime/core, luafilesystem, zlib — ship as separate `.so` files under `external/lib/`. These aren't in the pie because they're upstream binaries sized by their maintainers, outside Caspian's direct byte-budget control. The [core inventory](https://puck.uno/requirements/core/#contents) lists them with per-file sizes.
